ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_normalized_clipped_margin_loss
ir.intuition: Incorporates explicit clipping on the margin to limit extreme values, combined with normalization over the weighted loss to ensure scale invariance and stable gradients. This reduces sensitivity to outliers and stabilizes training.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
clipped_margin = clamp(margin, -margin_clip, margin_clip)
weighted_margin = alpha * clipped_margin - beta * delta_rank
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(weighted_margin)
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
norm = sum(weight) + epsilon
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / norm
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 0.05))
    margin_clip = float(extra.get('margin_clip', 5.0))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    clipped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -margin_clip, margin_clip)
    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, clipped_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(weighted_margin))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)
    return loss
